req_desc: The product serves a trilingual public site plus an operations console behind one sign-in ...
A `coordinator` places options, sets ranks, opens challenges, confirms bookings ...
Sign-in accepts an email plus a password, returning a bearer token carrying the principal email, the principal role ...
Every space carries a kind, a floor area in square metres, an entrance set, an availability calendar ...
A layout name is one of `theatre`, `cabaret`, `banquet`, `stand_grid`, `standing` ...
An enquiry carries a contact, a date range, an expected visitor count, an event type, spaces of interest ...
An option is a soft hold on a named space set across a named window, carrying an expiry, a rank ...
Confirmation creates the space set, the phase records, the contract record in one transaction ...
A booking phase kind is exactly one of `access`, `build_up`, `run`, `tear_down`, `clearance` ...
Loading docks, freight lifts, forklifts, rigging crews, power drops are finite scheduled resources ...
The planner canvas renders the true space geometry at scale from the space model ...
A party kind is one of `organiser`, `exhibitor`, `contractor`, `venue_staff`, `caterer`, `security`, `cleaner`, `visitor` ...
An entrance mode is one of `staff`, `contractor`, `exhibitor`, `trade`, `public`, `closed` ...
An entrance losing the connection of that entrance keeps deciding on the rule set last held ...
Live occupancy per space is derived from entrance scans, internal scans ...
The licensed figure of a space is bound to the exits available in the current approved plan ...
The venue sells catering, technical services, furniture, cleaning, waste, signage, parking allocations ...
A booking accrues charges from space hire, phase durations, services ordered ...
A publication state is exactly one of `private`, `announced`, `published` ...
The exhibitor surface shows the stand, the position on the approved plan, the accreditation, the badges ...
Work orders are scheduled against riggers, electricians, cleaners, forklifts, drivers, lifts, docks ...
Reports answer campus occupancy over time by space, by combination ...
External ticketing volumes are imported for occupancy forecasting ...
The visitor plan renders the entrance, the halls in use, the catering positions, the toilets, the exits ...
The annual view shows every hall across a year on one row each ...
The home hero carries the display line over a full-bleed generated image behind a dark scrim ...
An event card carries a generated image, a status chip, a title, a date range, a daily time range ...
The spaces route carries the interactive floor plan over one specification block per space ...
The meetings route carries the meeting rooms, the combinations, the audiovisual provision, a contact block ...
The visit hub carries accessibility, parking, food, drink, the city, the questions accordion ...
The about hub carries who we are, the fifty-year history, sustainability, safety, the media kit ...
The news index carries cards with category chips, dates, plus an article page per item ...
The contact route carries a first name, a last name, an email, an event kind, a date range ...
The legal routes carry the general conditions, the privacy policy, the cookie policy, each dated ...
A consent banner gates a statistics category, a marketing category, over a necessary category ...
The search overlay carries one field labelled `Search entire website` ...
A newsletter capture answers exactly one of `sent`, `invalid`, `already` ...
The language switcher preserves the current page plus the parameters of that page ...
An unknown address under any language prefix is answered as not found ...
The public routes exist under the three language prefixes `nl`, `fr`, `en` ...
An anonymous caller opening a console route is served `/signin` with the requested address remembered ...
Every list surface carries an empty state naming the one next action of that surface ...
The public north star is a large working building with a team behind that building ...
The layout is checked at a wide desktop width, a small tablet width, a phone width ...
The hero display line reads `when ideas need space` ...
No binary asset ships: no typeface file, no photograph, no icon file, no texture, no video, no logo file ...
The browser receives a static production bundle on first paint ...
All timestamps are UTC, rendered in the venue zone ...
The seeded spaces are `Hall 1`, `Hall 2`, `Hall 3`, `Hall 4`, `Hall 5`, `Hall 6`, `The Event Hall`, `MC 1`, `MC 2`, `MC 3`, `MC 4`, `The Concourse`, `The Transit` ...
One campus, one tenant, with no second venue, no cross-campus surface ...
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
A list endpoint returns a top-level JSON array ...
An in-memory array of holds, bookings, scans, audit events rebuilt at start is refused as a violation ...
